meta.name: The Naughty Nineties
meta.description: In the gay '90s, cardsharps take over a Mississippi riverboat from a kindly captain. Their first act is to change the showboat into a floating gambling house. A ham actor and his bumbling sidekick try to devise a way to help the captain regain ownership of the vessel.
meta.slogan: A Show Boat Load of Laughter!
